NONE: › suitable or right for a particular situation
› to be likely to do something or to often do something
› formal having a natural ability or skill
天資聰明的，有天賦的；聰明的

example: 中肯的評論／貼切的描述
The kitchen roof is apt to (= likely to) leak when it rains.
一下雨廚房屋頂就容易漏水。
She's in her eighties now and apt to be a little forgetful.
她已經80多歲了，有些健忘。
We have some particularly apt students in the class this year.
這學年班裡有幾個特別聰明的學生。
My son has no/little aptitude for sport.
我兒子天生就沒有體育細胞／沒甚麼體育天賦。
We will take your personal aptitudes and abilities into account.
我們會考慮你的個人天賦和才能。

NONE: › a test to find out if someone has a natural ability for a particular type of work

example: I had to take an aptitude test before I began training as a nurse.
我在接受護士訓練前，要參加一個能力傾向測驗。
